unavailable_fields.communication: Capability field reports status not_applicable with reason 'single-device task' (observations.json); distributed_backend is null and no NCCL/collective activity exists to measure.
unavailable_fields.gradient_bucket_identity: coverage.json shows 0 backward_associated_kernels and 0 autograd_ranges for this inference-only workload; there are no gradient buckets or post-accumulate buffers whose storage membership could be natively correlated, so bucket links are unobtainable rather than ambiguous.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_or_nvlink_bytes: Single-device task has no collectives; device_telemetry PCIe rates are device-wide readings over native sampling windows, not per-collective byte counts, and traffic must not be inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_transfer_separation: No NCCL communication exists in this task; even with nsys timelines, NCCL waiting cannot be separated from wire transfer, and there is nothing to attribute.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness after submit and consumer completion may remain unknown and cannot be claimed from this collector.
unavailable_fields.gpu_compute_durations_from_cprofile: python_runtime runs a separate warmed cProfile that perturbs execution; its inclusive/self times reflect host dispatch and binding costs, not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations.

plan.rationale: The torch collector already ran and coverage.json shows complete attribution for this single-device inference workload (66441/66441 CUDA kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 backward kernels, 0 autograd ranges), so the remaining open questions for maximizing generated_tokens_per_second are interval decomposition and host-vs-device bottleneck identification. execution_timeline is selected for its plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, and per-device intervals, which decomposes TTFT (256-token prefill) versus the 32 batch-1 decode steps and tests whether decode is submit/launch-bound; its passive CPU gradient post-accumulate callbacks are moot here and it is not used to replace any communication hook or drive search actions. python_runtime is selected to quantify host dispatch and binding costs (transformers 5.16.1 over torch 2.13.0) on the warmed call path, the prime suspect when batch-1 decode underutilizes the GPU, accepting that its perturbed inclusive/self times are not clean scores or GPU durations. device_telemetry is selected for NVML utilization and memory-used samples: device-wide low utilization during decode corroborates a host-bound conclusion and memory headroom informs later KV-cache or graph-capture feasibility; PCIe rates are not requested because model loading is outside timing and per-collective bytes do not exist. nsys is not selected: attribution is already complete, the workload is single-stream single-device with no overlap, graph-tracing, or attribution questions left open that nsys would resolve beyond the existing torch trace plus execution_timeline. collective_calibration is not selected because communication is not_applicable for a single-device inference task and its synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference experiment would calibrate nothing used here. candidate_diagnostics is deferred since no specific candidates are under evaluation at this collection step. All unobtainable dimensions are listed in unavailable_fields with observed reasons and remain unknown.
